description: Reloads the current page in the given pageId, equivalent to the browser reload button. Use as a recovery step when a page is stuck loading or in a degraded state before escalating to HITL.

ignoreCache.description: When true, bypass the HTTP cache during reload (hard reload). Defaults to false.

purpose.description: Describe why a reload is needed, e.g. "page is stuck loading" or "attempting recovery before HITL escalation"
